description: Defines the ReuseAllocatorBase class, a base class for custom memory allocators that manage memory outside of the allocated blocks, supporting fallback allocation and memory reuse strategies.

classes.name: ReuseAllocatorBase
classes.description: A base class for memory allocators that handle external metadata and support fallback allocators, memory reuse, and capacity management.

classes.name: MemoryBlock
classes.description: Represents a block of memory with address and size, supporting merge and allocation checks.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory of specified size, optionally with alignment.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Marks a memory block as free for reuse.

methods.name: GetCapacity
methods.description: Returns total capacity managed by the allocator.

methods.name: PrintAllocations
methods.description: Outputs current memory allocations for debugging.

methods.name: TryFree
methods.description: Attempts to free a memory block.
